intended_object: The standard fact (inferred from the docstring and name) that a pseudometric space which is T₀ is a metric space with the same distance. Here it is the metric space structure built on a T₀ pseudometric space.
explanation: The definition keeps the given PseudoMetricSpace structure, so the distance, topology, uniformity and bornology are unchanged. It adds only the separation axiom dist x y = 0 → x = y. It derives this axiom from Metric.inseparable_iff (zero distance is the same as being inseparable) and from T₀ (inseparable points are equal). This is exactly the usual statement, under the hypotheses it needs: T₀ is precisely what a pseudometric lacks to be a metric, and the type is arbitrary. Degenerate cases such as the empty type cause no issue, and no arbitrary choices or junk values are involved. It is an abbrev so that it can be used to build instances; that does not change its mathematical content.
